rationale_bullets: Three-way battle with genuinely different profiles: Gonzales (WCU career 20 st, 6,682 yds, 63%, 52-23 - #3 all-time at WCU; took majority of spring snaps, 'did a great job' - Albin 2026-07-08), Harrell (best 2025 grade: PFF 72.3/106, 737 yds at 67% before wk-4 ACL; rehab 'on schedule'), Loftis (1,415 yds, 55%, 8-8 - turnover-benched).

The favorite is an elite FCS producer with a two-level discount and 22 FBS dropbacks; the insurance is a 67%-completion returner coming off ACL; the floor is a below-average proven FBS starter. That's a real distribution, not a void.
2025 as-played was 21st pctile across the committee - the unit can clear that bar with either Gonzales-translates or Harrell-healthy.
38 = below-average with upside skew: above Illinois-RB-32, below the UNLV-LB-40 anchor; capped by the FCS translation + ACL variables (confidence L).
